description:
Explore your world with electric assist.
Color: Graphite Grey

Equipped with Bosch e-assist

With a whisper quiet motor capable of 75Nm of torque, this system is wickedly fun. Go from the “all-day ride” Eco mode to an exhilarating Turbo mode with a few clicks of a button on your Smart LED Remote.

The Bosch Smart System ushers in the digital eBike future by fully connecting the eBike Flow app with all eBike components. This allows for over-the-air updates and continuous new functions, like navigation and enhanced theft protection, keeping your eBike current and your riding experience personalized.

The All Terrain is rugged enough to take you off the beaten path… WAY off the beaten path! You will no longer be limited to paved bicycle paths or roads, and a world of possibilities awaits where the pavement ends! Two track dirt roads, gravel paths and hiking trails are now accessible on the All Terrain.

The All Terrain is a quality machine for casual and serious riders alike. With 24” wheels all around, and an aggressive tread pattern on the tires, the AT rolls over most obstacles with ease. Available with a traditional derailleur system and a robust, round tubed chro-moly steel frame, the AT provides a nimble, responsive ride. The seat features a breathable mesh fabric, fitted across a lightweight aluminum frame. With standard disc brakes and full seat adjustability, the AT is ready for adventure!

When you’re riding the All Terrain, very few destinations are off limits. The only decision you’ll have to make is where your next adventure will take you!

*Please note - This TerraTrike comes equipped with our Comfort Pedal Conversion Kit!

The Battery Network – Bosch Battery Fee
Please note: a $15 recycling fee will be added to the price of every Bosch product with the new Smart System. This program provides support for battery recycling to riders like you! Learn more about the initiative here: batterynetwork.org
